ns2:section.sectionText: This course begins with ballet basics; terminology; foundational movements, and ballet etiquette, with an intent to progress over the semester to take a full ballet class with work at a ballet barre and at the center of the room. This class will focus on training the body and muscles in turnout, ballet's relationship to classical music, and discussing ballet history and locality in comparison with current times. Restricted to Dance majors. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance or Dance and Kinesiology major(s).
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Dance department.
